nodes.speaker: class-redmage
nodes.line: Bolt. A lightning spell, and an old one. The Collector had no idea what he was sitting on.

nodes.speaker: character-commander
nodes.line: On a bare hilltop by the road, something catches the light. It glints at you, and only at you.

nodes.speaker: class-knight
nodes.line: There's nothing there. Grass and a rock.

nodes.speaker: class-redmage
nodes.line: There is for them. Look at the orbs. Take us up there.
